sensors.guide: Lint must pass on every file you touch; fix the code rather than the rule.
The project must typecheck before the turn ends.
Run the unit suite before claiming done; fix the code, never the tests.

sensors.cmd: if [ -f .rig/gen/dependency-cruiser.cjs ]; then npx --no-install depcruise src --config .rig/gen/dependency-cruiser.cjs --ignore-known .rig/gen/known-violations.json --output-type err; else echo 'layers: not enforced here (no approved layers config)'; fi
sensors.guide: Respect the approved layers in architecture.md; do not import across a forbidden boundary.

sensors.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d) && npx --yes jscpd@5.4.2 src --silent --reporters json --output "$d" >&2 && node -p "try{require('$d/jscpd-report.json').statistics.total.percentage}catch{0}"
sensors.guide: Reuse existing code instead of copying it; the duplicated share may not grow past its baseline.

sensors.cmd: if semgrep --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then semgrep scan --config p/default --error --metrics=off --disable-version-check --quiet {changed}; s=$?; [ $s -le 1 ] || [ -n "$CI" ] && exit $s; echo "sast: Semgrep could not scan here (exit $s: offline, or the rules did not load), so CI scans this change"; elif [ -n "$CI" ]; then echo 'sast: Semgrep does not run in CI (pipx install semgrep)'; exit 1; else echo 'sast: Semgrep does not run here (missing or broken), so CI scans this change (pipx install semgrep to scan locally)'; fi
sensors.guide: Semgrep scans the source files this change touches for security bugs (injection, unsafe input, secrets, weak crypto); fix the code rather than silencing the rule.
New code comes with tests that execute it; coverage alone does not prove behaviour.
Do not add dependencies with known high-severity vulnerabilities.

sensors.cmd: [ -x node_modules/.bin/stryker ] || { echo 'mutation-diff: Stryker is not installed: npm i -D @stryker-mutator/core, or the person waives mutation-diff'; exit 1; }; rm -rf reports/mutation; { npx --no-install stryker run --mutate {changed-lines:js,jsx,ts,tsx,mjs,cjs,mts,cts} --reporters json --logLevel warn; } >&2; node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning "$RIG_SDLC" mutscore --tool stryker --report reports/mutation/mutation.json --lines {changed-lines:js,jsx,ts,tsx,mjs,cjs,mts,cts}; s=$?; rm -rf reports/mutation; exit $s
sensors.guide: Every line this change adds is pinned by a test: the mutation score on the changed lines must reach mutation.minScore; a survivor names a line and a change no test noticed, and goes back to the test writer.
Tests must assert behaviour so that changing the code makes them fail.
